_: TWO CLIPS, DISSOLVING ACROSS THE SWEEP. `source.clips` names them and `source.blend` mixes — 0 is the first, 1 is the second. The point is that the dissolve is written into the tape A COLUMN AT A TIME while the head travels, so the left of the frame is one clip, the right is the other, and the middle is genuinely both. That is not a crossfade applied to a finished picture; the tape never held either clip whole. ADD THE MOSH PASS and the transition BLOOMS, because a fast dissolve looks to the block matcher exactly like a cut — mosh.refresh 0.94, bloom 1, sliceLoss 0.1. Put a `hand` lane on blend instead of a ramp for a dissolve that hesitates. Both clips must be in the media pool.
